title: 2140 Prairie's columned porch, crocketed dormers and tall chimney
items: The Tucker/Smith mansion at Prairie Avenue and 22nd Street now has the stone porch its photographs show before the front door: paired Corinthian columns under a balustraded balcony, with a broad stair down to the walk. Its mansard dormers rise in steep coped gables with crockets, pinnacles and finials, and the tall chimney on 22nd Street carries its row of four tall pots over sunk panels.
